units.title: Setup — TypeScript ka utna hissa jitna chahiye

lessons.name: TypeScript kyu, aur 5 minute ka setup
lessons.desc: TS = JavaScript + lebal. Aur bina kisi bhaari setup ke chalane ka tarika.
terms: JavaScript ka bada bhai — wahi language, par har cheez pe "ye kis type ki hai" ka lebal laga sakte ho.
TypeScript ko normal JavaScript mein badalna, kyunki browser sirf JavaScript samajhta hai.
Code chalne se PEHLE mili galti — jaise number ki jagah string daal dena.
lessons.what:
TypeScript koi nayi language nahi hai. Wo JavaScript hi hai, jisme tum har cheez pe ek lebal laga sakte ho ki "ye number hai", "ye string hai", "ye Vehicle hai".

Ye lebal browser ko nahi jaate. Chalne se pehle wo hat jaate hain aur normal JavaScript bach jaati hai. Unka kaam sirf ek hai: tumhe galti chalne se pehle batana.

Analogy: dawai ki botal pe lebal. Lebal dawai ka hissa nahi hai — patient ko wo nahi khani. Par lebal ki wajah se galat dawai lene se pehle pata chal jaata hai.
lessons.why:
Is kitaab ke liye TypeScript teen cheezein deta hai jo plain JS mein hain hi nahi. Abhi inhe samajhne ki zarurat nahi — bas naam sun lo, har ek ka apna chapter hai:

1. private aur protected — inse tum keh sakte ho "is data ko sirf is class ke andar se chhua ja sakta hai, bahar se nahi". (Chapter 3)
2. interface — ek list jisme likha ho ki koi cheez kya-kya kar sakti hai, bina ye bataye ki kaise karti hai. (Chapter 4)
3. abstract class — ek adhoori class, jise use karne se pehle poora karna padta hai. (Chapter 4)

In teeno ke bina OOP sikhna aisa hai jaise cricket bina bat ke sikhna.

Kaise karna hai:

Setup ka sabse aasan raasta: tsx. Ye ek chhota tool hai jo TypeScript file ko seedha chala deta hai — koi compile step nahi, koi config nahi.

npx tsx parking.ts — bas. File chal jaayegi.

Par ek dikkat hai: tsx types ko sirf hata deta hai, unhe check nahi karta. Yaani galti chup-chaap nikal jaayegi. Isliye saath mein npx tsc --noEmit --watch bhi chalate raho — wo ek alag terminal mein baith kar sirf galtiyan batata rahega.

Do terminal: ek chalane ke liye, ek check karne ke liye. Ye poori kitaab ka setup hai.
gotchas: "strict": true zaroor on karo. Bina iske TypeScript aadha soya rehta hai aur bahut si galtiyan chhod deta hai.
tsx types check nahi karta, sirf hata deta hai. Isliye dusra terminal (tsc --watch) chalana zaroori hai, warna tumhe lagega sab theek hai.
File ka extension .ts hona chahiye, .js nahi. Chhoti baat hai par 10 minute barbaad karwa deti hai.

lessons.name: Type, interface aur union — data ka shape batana
lessons.desc: Teen tarike se tum bata sakte ho ki ek cheez andar se dikhti kaisi hai.
terms: Colon lagakar likha gaya lebal — jaise let x: number.
Ek object ka naksha — usme kaunse field honge aur kis type ke.
"Ya to ye, ya wo" — jaise "car" | "bike", matlab in dono mein se koi ek.
Sawaal-nishaan wala field — ho bhi sakta hai, na bhi ho.
lessons.what:
Teen cheezein, teeno bahut simple:

1. Annotation — colon lagakar lebal: let umar: number = 25.
2. Interface — ek object ka naksha: "isme plate hoga jo string hai, aur size hoga jo number hai".
3. Union — "in mein se koi ek": type Size = "small" | "medium" | "large".

Union sabse zyada kaam ka hai. Uski wajah se tum "sirf ye teen value allowed hain" bata sakte ho, aur agar koi chauthi likhega to turant error milega.
lessons.why:
Parking lot mein ye teeno turant kaam aayenge. Ek gaadi ka size sirf teen cheezein ho sakta hai — small, medium, large. Agar wo plain string hoti, to koi "smal" likh deta (typo) aur wo galti chalte waqt pata chalti, wo bhi shayad mahine baad.

Union ke saath wo galti turant pakdi jaayegi — aur editor tumhe teeno options suggest bhi karega.

Kaise karna hai:

interface aur type dono se object ka naksha bana sakte ho. Farak zyada nahi hai. Ek simple niyam is kitaab ke liye:

• interface use karo jab tum ek cheez ka naksha bana rahe ho jise koi class implement karegi (Chapter 4 mein iska poora matlab khulega).
• type use karo union ke liye aur chhote shapes ke liye.

Aur ek chhota nishaan: ? ka matlab hai "ye field zaroori nahi hai".

visual.cap: Teen auzaar, teen kaam. Union sabse zyada kaam ka hai — wo "sirf ye value chalengi" bata deta hai, aur typo turant pakda jaata hai.

Optional field (?) padhte waqt undefined ho sakti hai. Use karne se pehle check karna padega, warna TypeScript rok dega — aur ye achhi baat hai.
interface aur type mein 90% cases mein koi farak nahi. Isme mat atko — is kitaab ka niyam upar likha hai, bas wahi follow karo.

lessons.name: Class ka syntax — field, constructor, method, this
lessons.desc: Syntax abhi seekh lo. Iska ASLI matlab Chapter 2 mein khulega.
terms: Ek naksha jisse ek jaisi kai cheezein banayi ja sakti hain.
Class ke andar rakha hua data — jaise gaadi ka number.
Class ke andar rakha hua function — jaise gaadi park karna.
Ek khaas method jo object banate hi apne aap chalta hai.
Class se bani hui ek asli cheez.
Method ke andar likha jaaye to iska matlab hai "wahi object jispe ye method chal raha hai".
lessons.what:
Abhi hum sirf syntax dekh rahe hain — ye kyu zaroori hai wo Chapter 2 mein aayega. Abhi bas haath ko aadat padne do.

Ek class ke chaar hisse hote hain:

Field — data. plate: string;
Constructor — object banate hi jo chalta hai. Yahan fields ko pehli value milti hai.
Method — kaam. Normal function jaisa, bas function shabd nahi likhna.
this — method ke andar "ye wala object".
lessons.why:
this par ek minute rukо, kyunki yahi sabse zyada confuse karta hai.

Ek class se tum hazaar object bana sakte ho. Method ka code sirf ek jagah likha hai, par wo hazaar alag objects pe chalta hai. To method ke andar "kaunsa object?" ka jawab chahiye — wo jawab hai this.

Analogy: school mein ek hi form chhapa hota hai, aur 500 bachche wahi form bharte hain. Form pe likha hai "apna naam likho" — "apna" ka matlab har bachche ke liye alag hai. Wahi this hai.

Kaise karna hai:

TypeScript ek shortcut deta hai jo bahut kaam ka hai: constructor ke parameter par hi public/private likh do, to wo field apne aap ban jaata hai.

Yaani teen line ka kaam ek line mein. Is kitaab mein hum ye shortcut har jagah use karenge — par pehle lamba tarika dekh lo, taaki tumhe pata ho ki shortcut kar kya raha hai.
gotchas: Method ke andar this. lagana bhoolna. plate likhoge to TypeScript kahega "Cannot find name plate" — kyunki wo field hai, local variable nahi.
new lagana bhoolna. const v = Vehicle(...) galat hai, const v = new Vehicle(...) sahi hai.
Arrow function ke andar this alag behave karta hai. Abhi ismein mat uljho — is kitaab mein hum normal methods hi use karenge.

units.title: Procedural ka pahaad — OOP kyu exist karta hai

lessons.name: Chalo ek parking lot banate hain — bina class ke
lessons.desc: Data alag, functions alag. Jaise zyadatar log pehli baar likhte hain.
terms: Aisa code jisme data alag pada hota hai aur usko badalne wale functions alag. Dono ke beech koi rishta nahi hota.
Aisa data jo file mein sabse upar pada ho aur koi bhi function use badal sakta ho.
Kisi cheez ko badal dena (naya banane ki jagah).
lessons.what:
Ek parking lot ko kya-kya chahiye? Seedhi si list:

• Kuch spots (jagah), har ek ka size aur floor
• Kaun si spot par kaun si gaadi khadi hai
• Gaadi andar aane par ek ticket
• Nikalte waqt paisa calculate karna

Ab ise sabse seedhe tarike se likhte hain: kuch arrays upar, kuch functions neeche. Bas.
lessons.why:
Ye tarika galat nahi hai. Chhote programs ke liye ye bilkul theek hai, aur bahut se achhe programs aise hi likhe jaate hain.

Problem tab shuru hoti hai jab program badhta hai aur kai log use chhoote hain. Aur wo problem hum aaj hi bana ke dekhenge — theory se nahi, apne code se.

Kaise karna hai:

Ek baat par dhyaan do jab likho: data aur usko badalne wale function ke beech koi rishta nahi hai.

spots ek array hai. park() ek function hai. TypeScript ko ye nahi pata ki dono ka koi lena-dena hai. Koi bhi doosra function bhi spots ko badal sakta hai — aur kisi ko pata nahi chalega.

Ye baat abhi chhoti lagegi. Chapter ke ant tak ye sabse badi baat ban jaayegi.
gotchas: Is code ko "bura" mat samjho. Ye kaam karta hai aur padhne mein saaf hai. Problem badhne par aati hai, aaj nahi.
Dhyaan do ki spots, tickets aur earnings — teeno file mein sabse upar khule pade hain. Yahi agli lesson ka poora vishay hai.

lessons.name: Ab isko todo — aur dekho ki kaun rok sakta tha
lessons.desc: Chaar line likho jo poore system ko jhooth bana dein. Aur kisi ko pata bhi nahi chalega.
terms: Ek niyam jo hamesha sach rehna chahiye — jaise "earnings kabhi negative nahi ho sakti".
Aisa data jo asambhav ho — jaise ek spot jo khali bhi hai aur bhari bhi.
lessons.what:
Ab neeche chaar line likho. Sab chalengi. Koi error nahi aayegi. Aur chaaron tumhare system ko jhooth bana dengi.

Ye baat samajhna zaroori hai: yahan TypeScript bhi tumhe nahi bacha sakta, kyunki types ke hisaab se sab kuch sahi hai. earnings ek number hai, aur -99999 bhi ek number hai.
lessons.why:
Asli sawaal ye nahi hai ki "kaun aisa karega?". Asli sawaal ye hai: agar kisi ne kar diya, to pata kaise chalega?

Ek 300 line ke file mein, jispe teen log kaam kar rahe hain, koi kabhi bhi spots ko chhoo sakta hai. Aur jab bug aayega, tumhe poori file mein dhundhna padega ki kisne kya badla.

Isko dhundhne ka koi tareeka nahi hai — kyunki data sabke liye khula hai.

Kaise karna hai:

Ab ek niyam likho jo hamesha sach hona chahiye. Aise niyam ko invariant kehte hain.

Hamare parking lot ke teen invariants hain:

1. earnings kabhi negative nahi ho sakti.
2. Ek spot ya to khali hai, ya usme ek gaadi hai. Do gaadi nahi.
3. Agar ticket zinda hai, to uski spot bhari honi chahiye.

Aaj tumhare code mein teeno tode ja sakte hain, aur code ko pata bhi nahi chalega. Ye is chapter ka asli output hai.

visual.cap: Data beech mein khula pada hai, aur har koi use seedha chhoo sakta hai. Har teer ek jagah hai jahan bug ghus sakta hai — aur system ko pata nahi chalega ki kisne kiya.

lessons.name: OOP kya hai — aur wo kya waada karta hai
lessons.desc: Ek line ka jawab: data aur uske niyam ko ek dabbe mein band kar do.
terms: Object-Oriented Programming — code ko "cheezon" (objects) ke around organize karna, jahan har cheez ka apna data aur apne kaam ek jagah hon.
Ek cheez jiske paas apna data bhi hai aur us data pe kaam karne wale functions bhi.
Data ko ek dabbe mein band karke uske aage darwaza lagana — bahar wale sirf darwaze se aayenge.
lessons.what:
Definition: Object-Oriented Programming is a way of organizing code around objects — bundles that keep data and the operations on that data together, and control who is allowed to change what.

Aasan bhasha mein: jo data saath mein rehna chahiye aur jo niyam us data pe lagne chahiye, unko ek dabbe mein band kar do — aur dabbe pe ek hi darwaza rakho.

Analogy: ATM. Andar paisa hai, aur uske niyam hain (PIN sahi ho, balance kaafi ho, limit se zyada na nikle). Tum machine kholkar seedha paisa nahi nikaal sakte. Tumhe darwaze se aana padta hai — card daalo, PIN do, amount maango. Aur us darwaze par machine har niyam check karti hai.

Procedural code ATM ki deewar tod kar paisa nikaalne jaisa hai. Chalega — par koi niyam nahi lagega.
lessons.why:
Ab wapas jao Chapter 1 ki chaar todne wali lines par. Un chaaron ka ek hi ilaaj hai: data ko seedha chhoone mat do.

Agar earnings ko sirf ek method (collectFee()) badal sakta ho, to:

• earnings = -99999 likhna namumkin ho jaayega
• Aur jab earnings galat hogi, tumhe ek hi jagah dekhni padegi

Yahi OOP ka pehla aur sabse bada waada hai: "agar kuch galat hua, to tumhe pata hoga ki dekhna kahan hai."

Kaise karna hai:

OOP ke chaar bade hisse hote hain (log inhe "chaar stambh" ya four pillars kehte hain). Hum chaaron banayenge, par ek saath nahi — jab-jab zarurat padegi:

Encapsulation (Ch 3) — data ke aage darwaza. Aaj ki problem ka seedha jawab.
Abstraction (Ch 4) — bahar wale ko sirf zaroori cheez dikhao, andar ka jhanjhat nahi.
Inheritance (Ch 5) — milti-julti cheezon ka saanjha hissa ek jagah.
Polymorphism (Ch 6) — ek hi naam, alag-alag cheezon ke liye alag kaam.

Aur ek imaandar baat: OOP har problem ka jawab nahi hai. Chapter 12 mein hum dekhenge ki wo kab galat choice hoti hai.

units.title: Class aur Object — data aur kaam ek jagah

lessons.name: Class = naksha, Object = asli cheez
lessons.desc: Ek naksha, hazaar imaaratein. Har imaarat ka apna alag data.
terms: Ek naksha — batata hai ki cheez mein kya-kya hoga, par khud wo cheez nahi hai.
Naksha se bani hui ek asli cheez. Ek class se jitne chaaho bana sakte ho.
Naksha se ek nayi asli cheez banane wala shabd.
lessons.what:
Class ek naksha hai. Object us naksha se bani hui asli cheez hai.

Analogy: ek builder ke paas ek flat ka naksha hai. Us naksha se wo 200 flats banata hai. Naksha mein likha hai "do kamre, ek kitchen". Par har flat mein alag log rehte hain, alag saaman hai.

Naksha = class. Flat = object. Naksha mein koi nahi reh sakta — usme rehne ke liye flat banana padta hai.

Isliye new lagana zaroori hai. new ParkingLot() ka matlab hai "naksha se ek asli parking lot bana do".
lessons.why:
Ye baat sirf shabdon ka khel nahi hai. Iska seedha practical matlab hai: har object ka apna alag data hota hai.

Agar tumhe do parking lots chahiye — ek airport wali, ek mall wali — to procedural code mein tumhe poora file copy karna padta (kyunki spots ek hi global array hai). Class ke saath tum bas new do baar likh do.

Aur ye Chapter 12 tak bahut kaam aayega, jab hum testing karenge: har test apna taaza parking lot bana sakta hai, purane test ki gandagi se bina prabhavit hue.

Kaise karna hai:

Do shabd yaad rakho, kyunki interview mein ye seedha poocha jaata hai:

Class = definition, ek baar likhi jaati hai, memory mein ek hi hoti hai.
Instance = us class se bana ek object, har baar new se naya banta hai, apni alag memory ke saath.

Ek aur cheez: methods har object ke liye copy nahi hoti. Method ka code ek hi jagah rehta hai; sirf data alag hota hai. Isliye 10,000 objects banane par bhi method ka code ek hi baar memory mein hai.

visual.cap: Ek naksha, teen asli cheezein. Naksha mein sirf "kya hoga" likha hai; asli data har object ka apna hai. Methods ka code ek hi jagah rehta hai — sirf data alag hota hai.

gotchas: new lagana bhoolna sabse aam galti hai. TypeScript mein wo error dega, plain JS mein wo chup-chaap undefined de deta hai.
Class ko object mat samjho. class ParkingLot likhne se koi parking lot ban nahi jaata — wo sirf naksha hai. Asli cheez new se banti hai.
Agar ek hi cheez chahiye poore program mein (jaise ek hi database connection), to log Singleton pattern use karte hain — par wo aksar galat choice hoti hai. Chapter 11 mein dekhenge kyu.

lessons.name: Parking lot ko class banao — data aur kaam ek jagah
lessons.desc: Wahi code, par ab spots aur park() ek hi cheez ke hisse hain.
terms: Jo cheezein saath rehni chahiye wo saath hon. Zyada cohesion = achha design.
Code ka behaviour badle bina uska dhaancha sudharna.
lessons.what:
Ab wahi procedural code ko class mein daalte hain. Behaviour bilkul nahi badlega — sirf jagah badlegi.

Global spots ban jaayega this.spots. Global park() ban jaayega ek method. Aur ab dono ek hi cheez ke hisse hain.

Behaviour badle bina dhaancha sudharne ko refactor kehte hain. Ye is kitaab mein hum baar-baar karenge.
lessons.why:
Do cheezein turant behtar ho jaati hain:

1. Padhne mein. Ab koi bhi ParkingLot class kholega to use ek hi jagah dikh jaayega ki isme kya data hai aur uspe kya kaam hote hain. Pehle use poori file scan karni padti.

2. Ginne mein. Ab tum gin sakte ho ki spots ko kitni jagah se badla jaata hai — kyunki wo sirf class ke andar hai. (Abhi bhi bahar se chhua ja sakta hai, par ab tumhe pata hai ki dekhna kahan hai.)

Isko cohesion kehte hain: jo saath rehna chahiye wo saath hai. Ye Chapter 9 mein poora topic banega.

Kaise karna hai:

Refactor karte waqt ek niyam: ek baar mein ek cheez.

Pehle sirf data andar le jao aur code chala kar dekho. Phir ek-ek method andar le jao, har baar chala kar. Sab kuch ek saath badloge to jab kuch tootega tumhe pata nahi chalega ki kya toota.

Aur ek chhoti par bahut kaam ki baat: ParkingLot ko Spot aur Ticket bhi classes banani chahiye ya nahi? Jawab: haan, agar unke apne niyam hain. Spot ke apne niyam hain (khali/bhari), Ticket ke bhi (kab andar aaya, kitna hua). To teeno class banengi.
gotchas: Sab kuch ek saath refactor mat karo. Pehle data andar, chalao. Phir ek method, chalao. Ye discipline aage bade refactors mein tumhe bachayega.
this. lagana bhoolna — spots.find(...) likhoge to error milegi kyunki wo ab field hai, global nahi. Ye achhi error hai, isse pata chalta hai ki refactor sach mein hua.
Spot aur Ticket ko sirf interface (plain object) rakhne ka mann karega. Par unke apne niyam hain (isFree, hoursParked), isliye wo classes honi chahiye — data ke saath uske kaam bhi.

lessons.name: Constructor — object ko sahi haalat mein paida karna
lessons.desc: Ek object banate hi valid hona chahiye. Aadhe bane object sabse bade bug hote hain.
terms: Object banate hi apne aap chalne wala khaas method — yahan object ki shuruaati haalat set hoti hai.
Aisi haalat jisme object ke saare niyam sach hon.
Ek hi naam ke kai versions — alag-alag arguments ke liye. JavaScript/TypeScript mein wo asli nahi hota.
lessons.what:
Constructor ek khaas method hai jo new lagate hi apne aap chalta hai. Uska ek hi kaam hai: object ko paida hote hi sahi haalat mein laana.

Agar tum constructor nahi likhte, to TypeScript ek khaali constructor khud maan leta hai — aur tumhara object bina kisi data ke paida hota hai.
lessons.why:
Ye baat sunne mein choti lagti hai par bahut badi hai: ek object kabhi bhi galat haalat mein maujood nahi hona chahiye — ek pal ke liye bhi nahi.

Socho ek ParkingLot bana jiska name khaali hai aur spots undefined hai. Wo ek "aadha bana" object hai. Ab agar koi uspe park() chala de, to crash — aur crash ki jagah se tumhe kabhi pata nahi chalega ki asli galti object banate waqt hui thi.

Isliye niyam: constructor mein hi check karo, aur galat data pe object banne hi mat do.

Kaise karna hai:

TypeScript mein constructor overloading asli nahi hai — yaani tum do alag constructors nahi likh sakte. Iske teen tarike hain:

1. Optional parameters — constructor(name: string, floors = 1)
2. Ek object parameter — constructor(config: LotConfig). Jab 3 se zyada parameter hon to yahi best hai.
3. Static factory method — ParkingLot.fromConfig(...). Naam de sakte ho, jo constructor mein nahi de sakte.

Teesra tareeka Chapter 11 mein Factory pattern ban jaayega. Abhi bas dekh lo ki wo yahan se aaya hai.
gotchas: Constructor mein bhaari kaam (database call, file read, network) mat karo. Object banana turant hona chahiye. Bhaari kaam ke liye static factory use karo.
Constructor se kuch return mat karo. Wo apne aap object return karta hai; explicit return karne se ajeeb behaviour aata hai.
3 se zyada parameters ho jaayein to object parameter par switch kar do. new Lot("A", 5, 100, 0, true) mein 6 mahine baad koi nahi bata payega ki kaunsa kya hai.

lessons.name: public, private, protected — kaun kya dekh sakta hai
lessons.desc: Teen level. Aur ek chauthi cheez jo TypeScript aur JavaScript mein alag hai.
terms: Sab dekh sakte hain, sab badal sakte hain. Default yahi hota hai.
Sirf ussi class ke andar ka code dekh sakta hai.
Ussi class ke andar, aur uske bachchon (subclass) ke andar. Chapter 5 mein kaam aayega.
Ye teen shabd — jo batate hain ki kaun kya chhoo sakta hai.
lessons.what:
Teen level hote hain, aur teeno ka matlab ek hi sawaal ka jawab hai: "is cheez ko kaun chhoo sakta hai?"

public — koi bhi. Ye default hai, isliye agar tum kuch nahi likhte to sab kuch public hai.
private — sirf ussi class ke andar likha hua code.
protected — ussi class ka code, aur us class se bane bachchon ka code. (Bachche Chapter 5 mein aayenge.)
lessons.why:
Ye sirf "chhupane" ke liye nahi hai. Iska asli faayda ye hai: jab tum kuch private kar dete ho, to tum us cheez ko baad mein bina kisi ko toda badal sakte ho.

Socho tumne #spots ko array se Map bana diya kyunki dhundhna tez karna tha. Agar wo public hota, to poore codebase mein jitne log lot.spots[0] likh rahe the, sab toot jaate. Private hai, to sirf class ke andar ka code badalna padega.

Isko "badalne ki azadi" kehte hain — aur ye badi codebases mein sabse keemti cheez hai.

Kaise karna hai:

TypeScript mein private do tarah se likha ja sakta hai, aur dono mein bada farak hai:

1. private balance — TypeScript wala private. Sirf compile time par check hota hai. Chalte waqt wo normal field hai; koi (lot as any).balance likh kar chhoo sakta hai.

2. #balance — JavaScript wala asli private. Ye chalte waqt bhi private hai. Bahar se chhoone ki koshish par asli error milti hai.

Is kitaab mein hum # use karenge jahan data ko sach mein bachana hai, aur private wahan jahan sirf "ye andar ka hai" batana hai. Aur ye farak interview mein poocha jaata hai.

visual.cap: Teen level, aur teen alag darwaze. Aur neeche wo farak jo interview mein poocha jaata hai: TypeScript ka private sirf lebal hai, JavaScript ka # asli taala hai.

gotchas: Sab kuch private mat kar do. Jo cheez bahar wale ko chahiye wo public honi chahiye — warna log workaround dhundhenge aur design se bhi bura ho jaayega.
# field ke liye tsconfig mein "target" ES2022 ya usse naya hona chahiye. Purana target hoga to TypeScript ek ajeeb WeakMap wala code banata hai jo slow hai.
readonly sirf reassign rokta hai. readonly spots: Spot[] mein tum abhi bhi spots.push() kar sakte ho. Ye bahut log bhool jaate hain — Chapter 9 mein iska poora ilaaj hai.

lessons.name: Getter aur setter — padhne do, badalne mat do
lessons.desc: Data bahar dikhana hai par badalne nahi dena. Aur setter aksar galat jawab hota hai.
terms: Ek method jo data padh kar deta hai, par badalne nahi deta.
Ek method jo data badalta hai — aur badalte waqt niyam check kar sakta hai.
Aisi value jo store nahi hoti, har baar nikaali jaati hai — jaise "kitni spots khali hain".
lessons.what:
#earnings private kar diya — par ab report banane wale ko wo chahiye. To kya karein?

Getter banao: ek method jo value padh kar de par badalne na de.

TypeScript mein do tarike hain: normal method (getEarnings()) ya get keyword (get earnings()). Dusre wale ko tum property ki tarah padhte ho — lot.earnings — par wo asal mein ek method hai.
lessons.why:
Ab ek zaroori baat, jo bahut se OOP tutorials galat sikhate hain.

Har private field ke liye getter aur setter bana dena poore point ko khatam kar deta hai.

Agar tumne #earnings private kiya aur phir setEarnings() bhi bana diya, to tumne kuch nahi bachaya — koi bhi lot.setEarnings(-99999) likh sakta hai. Tumne bas ek lamba raasta bana diya wahi galti karne ka.

Sahi sawaal ye hai: "bahar wale ko is data ke saath kya kaam karna hai?" Report banani hai? To sirf getter do. Fee jama karni hai? To collectFee(amount) do — jo andar niyam check karega.

Kaise karna hai:

Ek achha niyam:

• Getter — jab bahar wale ko value dekhni hai. Aksar sahi.
• Setter — jab bahar wale ko value seedha set karni hai. Aksar galat. Uski jagah ek kaam wala method do (collectFee, park) jo apne andar niyam check kare.

Aur ek chhoti par pyaari cheez: kuch values store karni hi nahi chahiye. "Kitni spots khali hain" ko store karoge to wo purani ho sakti hai. Usko har baar nikaal lo. Aise value ko derived value kehte hain, aur wo kabhi galat nahi ho sakti.
gotchas: Har field ke liye getter+setter banana = private ka poora point khatam. Ye sabse aam OOP galti hai.
Array ya object ka getter seedha andar wali cheez de deta hai — aur bahar wala use badal sakta hai. Copy do ([...arr]) ya readonly do.
get earnings() aur #earnings ka naam ek jaisa nahi ho sakta bina # ke. Isliye TypeScript mein log _earnings likhte hain — par # behtar hai.
Getter ke andar bhaari kaam mat karo. Log samajhte hain ki wo ek property hai (sasta), aur usko loop mein 1000 baar padh lete hain.

lessons.name: Invariants — niyam ko darwaze par khada karo
lessons.desc: Ab jab raasta ek hai, to check bhi ek jagah lagega. Aur phir wo kabhi tootega nahi.
terms: Ek niyam jo hamesha sach rehna chahiye.
Method ke shuru mein lagaya gaya check jo galat input ko andar hi nahi aane deta.
Galti hote hi turant rukna, na ki aage badhkar chup-chaap galat kaam karna.
lessons.what:
Chapter 1 mein tumne teen invariants likhe the:

1. earnings kabhi negative nahi
2. Ek spot mein zyada se zyada ek gaadi
3. Zinda ticket ki spot bhari honi chahiye

Ab jab data private hai aur badalne ka raasta ek hai, to check bhi ek jagah lag sakta hai — aur phir wo niyam kabhi nahi tootega.
lessons.why:
Yahi encapsulation ka asli inaam hai, aur ye "chhupana" se bahut bada hai.

Procedural code mein agar tum chahte ki earnings kabhi negative na ho, to tumhe har us jagah check lagana padta jahan earnings badalti hai — aur ek jagah bhoolna kaafi tha.

Ab? Ek hi jagah hai. Ek hi check. Aur wo check bypass nahi kiya ja sakta, kyunki dusra raasta hai hi nahi.

Kaise karna hai:

Do tarike hain galat input handle karne ke:

1. throw — "ye hona hi nahi chahiye tha, ye programmer ki galti hai". Jaise negative fee.
2. return null ya koi result object — "ye ho sakta hai, ye normal hai". Jaise parking full.

Farak ye hai: throw un cheezon ke liye jo bug hain, return un cheezon ke liye jo zindagi hai. Parking full hona bug nahi hai, wo roz hota hai. Negative fee bug hai.

Aur fail fast: galti hote hi ruko. Chup-chaap 0 return karke aage mat badho — wo bug ko chhupa deta hai aur baad mein kahin aur crash karwata hai.

Chup-chaap 0 ya null return karke bug chhupana sabse khatarnak hai. Chapter 1 ke code mein unpark() galat ticket pe 0 deta tha — aur wo bug kabhi pakda hi nahi jaata.
Niyam ko us class mein rakho jiska wo niyam hai. "Ek spot, ek gaadi" ParkingLot ka niyam nahi hai — wo Spot ka niyam hai. Isse ParkingLot bhi use tod nahi sakti.

lessons.name: Apni Error classes — galti ko bhi ek cheez banao
lessons.desc: throw new Error("kuch galat") se caller kuch nahi kar sakta. Error bhi ek class honi chahiye.
terms: Ek cheez jo tab banti hai jab kuch galat ho, aur jo code ko rok kar upar chali jaati hai.
Galti ko phenkna — "main aage nahi badh sakta".
Apni Error classes ka ek parivaar, jisme sabka ek saanjha baap ho.
lessons.what:
Abhi tumhara code aisa likhta hai:

throw new Error("Spot bhari hai")

Ye chalta hai. Par sochо ki caller ko kya milta hai — bas ek string. Aur string se code faisla nahi kar sakta.

Agar UI ko ye batana ho ki "parking full hai to dusra message dikhao, par plate galat hai to form highlight karo" — to use e.message === "Spot bhari hai" likhna padega. Aur jis din tum message ka ek shabd badloge, uska code chup-chaap toot jaayega.
lessons.why:
Ilaaj wahi hai jo poori kitaab mein hai: galti ko bhi ek cheez (class) bana do.

Phir teen cheezein milti hain:

1. Caller instanceof se pehchaan sakta hai — aur ye un 10% jagahon mein se hai jahan instanceof sahi hai (Chapter 6).
2. Error apne saath data le ja sakta hai — kaunsi spot, kaunsi plate, kitni der.
3. Ek saanjha baap banane se caller ek hi catch mein poora parivaar pakad sakta hai.

Kaise karna hai:

Ek chhoti par zaroori TypeScript detail: class MyError extends Error likhne par instanceof kabhi-kabhi kaam nahi karta (purane compile targets par). Ilaaj ek line hai — constructor mein Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype).

Aur ek design niyam: har chhoti cheez ke liye alag Error class mat banao. Ek saanjha baap (ParkingError) aur uske 3-4 bachche kaafi hain. Agar caller do errors mein farak nahi karega, to unhe alag banane ka koi matlab nahi.
gotchas: extends Error ke baad Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype) likhna zaroori hai, warna instanceof kabhi-kabhi false de dega — aur ye bug dhundhna bahut mushkil hai.
Har chhoti cheez ke liye alag Error class mat banao. Agar caller do errors mein farak nahi karega, to unhe alag banane ka koi matlab nahi.
catch (e) mein "else throw e" likhna mat bhoolo. Jo error tumhara nahi hai use nigal jaana sabse khatarnak hai — wo bug hamesha ke liye chhup jaata hai.
Normal cheezon (parking full) ke liye error mat phenko. Wo abhi bhi return null hai — Chapter 3 wala niyam yahan bhi lagta hai.

units.title: Abstraction — kya hota hai, kaise hota hai chhupao

lessons.name: Abstraction kya hai — aur encapsulation se kaise alag
lessons.desc: Ek data chhupata hai, dusra tarika. Dono ek saath chalte hain.
terms: Andar ka jhanjhat chhupa kar bahar sirf zaroori cheez dikhana.
Ek waada — "main ye kaam kar sakta hu", bina ye bataye ki kaise.
lessons.what:
Sochо tum gaadi chalate ho. Tum steering ghumate ho aur gaadi mud jaati hai. Tumhe ye jaanne ki zarurat nahi ki andar rack-and-pinion hai ya hydraulic.

Steering wheel ek abstraction hai: wo batata hai ki kya ho sakta hai (mudna), aur kaise hota hai wo chhupa deta hai.

Aur sabse achhi baat: agar company steering ka andar ka mechanism badal de, tumhe dobara gaadi chalana nahi seekhna padta. Yahi abstraction ka poora inaam hai.

Definition: Abstraction means exposing what an object can do while hiding how it does it.
lessons.why:
Farak yaad rakhne ka sabse aasan tarika:

Encapsulation — "meri tijori ko haath mat lagao." (data)
Abstraction — "tumhe ye jaanne ki zarurat nahi ki tijori kis company ki hai aur uska lock kaise kaam karta hai." (tarika)

Dono ek saath chalte hain. Encapsulation abstraction ko mumkin banata hai: agar data private nahi hoga to tumhara "tarika" chhupega hi nahi, kyunki log data seedha chhoo kar apna tarika bana lenge.

Kaise karna hai:

Hamare parking lot mein abhi abstraction ki do jagah zarurat hai:

1. Payment. ParkingLot ko sirf itna pata hona chahiye: "paisa liya jaa sakta hai". Cash, UPI, card — ye uska sar-dard nahi hona chahiye.

2. Vehicle. Har gaadi ka apna size aur apna rate hai. ParkingLot ko poochna chahiye "tera rate kya hai", na ki khud if-else se decide karna.

Dono ke liye alag auzaar chahiye — aur agli do lessons wahi hain.

visual.cap: Ek hi cheez ke do pehlu. Encapsulation data ko bachata hai; abstraction tarika chhupata hai. Aur abstraction tabhi tik sakta hai jab encapsulation pehle se ho.

lessons.name: Interface — "main ye kaam kar sakta hu" ka waada
lessons.desc: Sirf naam aur shape. Koi code nahi. Aur ek class kai interfaces le sakti hai.
terms: Ek list jisme sirf ye likha ho ki kaunse kaam ho sakte hain — unka code nahi.
Ek class ka ye kehna ki "main is interface ka waada poora karti hu".
Waada — agar tumne implements likha, to har method banana hi padega.
lessons.what:
Ek interface sirf ek list hai: "jo bhi ye interface le, usme ye-ye methods honi chahiye."

Usme koi code nahi hota — sirf naam, arguments aur return type. Wo ek waada hai, ek kaam nahi.

Analogy: bijli ka socket. Socket kehta hai "do pin, itni distance par". Ab uske andar fan lagao, charger lagao, ya lamp — socket ko farak nahi padta. Socket = interface, plug = class jo use implement karti hai.
lessons.why:
Interface ka asli faayda ye hai: ek class kai interfaces le sakti hai.

Ek gaadi Parkable bhi ho sakti hai aur Chargeable bhi (electric hai to). Ek payment method PaymentMethod bhi ho sakta hai aur Refundable bhi.

Class ke saath ye nahi hota — ek class ka sirf ek baap ho sakta hai (Chapter 5 mein dekhenge kyu). Isliye jab "ye cheez kai tarah ki ho sakti hai" wali baat ho, interface hi sahi jawab hai.

Kaise karna hai:

TypeScript mein ek chhoti par badi baat hai: implements likhna zaroori nahi hai.

TypeScript "structural typing" use karta hai — matlab agar tumhari class mein sahi methods hain, to wo apne aap us interface ki tarah kaam karegi, chahe tumne implements likha ho ya nahi.

Phir bhi implements likho. Kyunki wo do cheezein deta hai: (1) padhne wale ko turant pata chal jaata hai ki iska iraada kya hai, aur (2) agar tum galti se method ka naam galat likh do, to error class mein milegi, na ki 10 file door jahan use kiya gaya tha.
gotchas: Interface sirf compile time par hota hai — chalte waqt wo gayab ho jaata hai. Isliye "x instanceof PaymentMethod" nahi likh sakte. Uske liye ek field (name) rakhna padta hai.
implements likhna optional hai par likho hi. Warna method ka naam galat likhne par error 10 file door milegi, jahan dhundhna mushkil hai.
Interface mein bahut saari methods mat daalo. Agar ek class ko aadhi methods khaali chhodni pad rahi hain, to interface ko todna chahiye — ye Chapter 10 ka "I" (Interface Segregation) hai.

lessons.name: Abstract class — adhoori class jise poora karna zaroori hai
lessons.desc: Kuch code de deti hai, kuch tumse likhwati hai. Aur ye interface se kab behtar hai.
terms: Ek adhoori class — usse seedha object nahi bana sakte, use poora karna padta hai.
Sirf naam, koi code nahi — bachche ko likhna hi padega.
Poori bani hui class jisse object ban sakta hai.
lessons.what:
Abstract class ek aisi class hai jo adhoori hai. Usse tum seedha object nahi bana sakte — pehle use poora karna padta hai.

Usme do tarah ki cheezein hoti hain:

• Poori methods — jo sabke liye ek jaisi hain, code ke saath.
• Abstract methods — sirf naam, koi code nahi. Har bachche ko khud likhni padengi.

Analogy: ek adha bhara hua form. Kuch cheezein pehle se chhapi hain (school ka naam, address) — sabke liye same. Kuch khaali hain (tumhara naam, roll number) — har bachche ko khud bharni hain. Adha bhara form khud koi student nahi hai; use bharna padta hai.
lessons.why:
Interface aur abstract class mein ek hi bada farak hai:

Interface — sirf waada, koi code nahi. Ek class kai le sakti hai.
Abstract class — waada aur saanjha code. Ek class sirf ek le sakti hai.

Isliye niyam bahut seedha hai:

• Agar tumhare paas saanjha code hai jo sab bachchon mein same hai → abstract class
• Agar sirf waada hai aur har koi apna tarika likhega → interface
• Agar ek cheez kai roop mein ho sakti hai → interface (kyunki ek class ka ek hi baap hota hai)

Kaise karna hai:

Hamare parking lot mein: har gaadi ke paas plate hai, aur describe() sabke liye same likha ja sakta hai. Par getSize() aur getHourlyRate() har gaadi ke apne hain.

Yaani: kuch saanjha, kuch alag — bilkul abstract class wali situation.

Aur ek bahut kaam ki baat: dono ek saath use kar sakte ho. Ek abstract class jo ek interface implement kare — ye asli code mein sabse aam pattern hai.

gotchas: Abstract class mein constructor ho sakta hai — aur hona bhi chahiye, kyunki saanjha data wahin set hota hai. Bas usse seedha object nahi banta.
Agar abstract class mein ek bhi abstract method nahi hai, to shayad use abstract hone ki zarurat hi nahi.
Abstract class deep hierarchy ko bulawa deti hai (Vehicle → Car → ElectricCar → ...). Ye Chapter 7 ki deewar banegi. Abhi maza lo, dard baad mein.
TypeScript mein abstract class chalte waqt ek normal class hi hai. "abstract" sirf compiler ka lebal hai.

lessons.name: ADT — interface aur implementation ka farak
lessons.desc: Stack, Queue, Map — ye "kya karta hai" hain, "kaise bana hai" nahi.
terms: Abstract Data Type — ek data structure ki definition uske kaam se, uske andar ke banawat se nahi.
Us ADT ko asal mein banane ka ek tarika — array se, linked list se, ya kuch aur.
lessons.what:
Ye abstraction ka sabse saaf udaharan hai, aur interview mein bahut poocha jaata hai.

Stack kya hai? Wo ek cheez hai jisme tum push kar sakte ho aur pop kar sakte ho, aur jo aakhir mein daala wo pehle nikalta hai.

Dhyaan do — maine ye nahi bataya ki wo andar se kya hai. Wo array se bana ho sakta hai, linked list se, ya kuch aur. Stack ek ADT hai: uski pehchaan uske kaam se hai, uski banawat se nahi.
lessons.why:
Isse ek badi baat samajh aati hai: List, Stack, Queue, Map, Set — ye sab interfaces hain. Aur ArrayList, LinkedList, HashMap, TreeMap — ye implementations hain.

Aur isi wajah se ek bahut kaam ka niyam nikalta hai: "program to an interface, not an implementation."

Yaani apne code mein likho "mujhe ek List chahiye", na ki "mujhe ek ArrayList chahiye". Phir kal tum implementation badal sakte ho aur kisi ka code nahi tootega.

Kaise karna hai:

Hamare parking lot mein iska seedha use hai. Abhi #spots ek array hai. Kal wo Map ban sakta hai (tez dhundhne ke liye), ya database (jab lot bada ho jaaye).

Agar hum ek SpotRepository interface bana dein — "spots dhundh sakte ho, save kar sakte ho" — to ParkingLot ko kabhi pata nahi chalega ki andar array hai ya database.

Ye Chapter 10 ka "D" (Dependency Inversion) ka beej hai. Abhi bas ye dekh lo ki wo yahan se aata hai.
gotchas: Har chhoti cheez ke liye repository interface mat bana do. Ye over-engineering hai. Interface tab banao jab sach mein do se zyada implementations ki zarurat ho ya test ke liye nakli chahiye.
JavaScript ka Array asal mein List, Stack aur Queue teeno ki tarah use hota hai (push/pop/shift). Isliye JS mein ye farak dikhta nahi — par interview mein wo poocha jaata hai.
Interface ka naam "IParkingLot" mat rakho. Ye purani C# ki aadat hai. Naam saaf rakho: SpotRepository, PaymentMethod.

lessons.name: Generics — ek dhaancha, kai types
lessons.desc: Ek hi Repository jo Spot ke liye bhi chale aur Ticket ke liye bhi — bina type khoye.
terms: Aisi class ya function jisme type ek khaali jagah ki tarah chhod di jaati hai, aur use karte waqt bhari jaati hai.
Wo khaali jagah — aksar T likhi jaati hai.
Khaali jagah par ek shart — "T kuch bhi ho sakta hai, par usme id honi chahiye".
TypeScript ka "kuch bhi chalega" — jo saari type checking band kar deta hai.
lessons.what:
Tumne SpotRepository banaya. Kal TicketRepository chahiye hoga, phir VehicleRepository. Teeno ka code bilkul ek jaisa hoga — sirf type alag.

Do bure hal hain:

1. Copy-paste — teen files, ek jaisa code. Bug bhi teen jagah theek karna padega.
2. any use karo — ek hi Repository jo "kuch bhi" rakhe. Par phir repo.find() ka jawab bhi any hoga, aur TypeScript ka poora faayda khatam.

Generics teesra hal hai: type ko ek khaali jagah chhod do, aur use karte waqt bharo.
lessons.why:
Ye abstraction ka hi ek roop hai — bas ek level upar.

Interface kehta hai: "mujhe ye kaam chahiye, tarika koi bhi ho."
Generic kehta hai: "mujhe ye dhaancha chahiye, type koi bhi ho."

Aur sabse zaroori: any ke ulat, generic type nahi khota. Repository<Spot> ka find() tumhe Spot deta hai, any nahi. Yaani suvidha bhi mili aur suraksha bhi.

Tum ise pehle se use kar rahe ho aur shayad dhyaan nahi gaya: Array<number>, Map<string, Spot>, Set<string> — teeno generics hain.

Kaise karna hai:

Sabse kaam ki cheez hai constraint — extends lagakar khaali jagah par shart lagana.

class Repository<T> — T kuch bhi ho sakta hai. Par phir tum item.id nahi likh sakte, kyunki T mein id ho bhi sakti hai aur nahi bhi.

class Repository<T extends { id: string }> — ab T kuch bhi ho sakta hai jisme id ho. Aur ab item.id likhna safe hai.

Ek chetavani: generic tab banao jab do se zyada types ke liye sach mein zarurat ho. Ek type ke liye generic banana sirf code ko padhne mein mushkil karta hai.
gotchas: Ek hi type ke liye generic mat banao. Agar sirf Spot chahiye to plain SpotRepository behtar hai — generic padhne mein bhaari hota hai.
any use karke "kaam chala lena" sabse aam galti hai. Wo TypeScript ki saari checking band kar deta hai. Agar type nahi pata to unknown use karo, any nahi.
Constraint (extends) lagana bhool jaana — phir tum T ke andar kuch bhi use nahi kar paoge, aur mann karega ki any laga do.
T, U, K, V naam theek hain chhote generics ke liye. Par agar teen se zyada type parameters ho jaayein to poore naam do (TEntity, TKey) — warna 6 mahine baad koi nahi samjhega.

lessons.name: extends aur super — muft mein saaman
lessons.desc: Bachcha baap ka sab kuch paata hai, aur usme apna jod sakta hai.
terms: Ek class ka doosri class se sab kuch (fields + methods) apne aap mil jaana.
Wo class jisse liya ja raha hai. Teeno naam ek hi cheez ke hain.
Wo class jo le rahi hai. Teeno naam ek hi cheez ke hain.
Baap wale version ko bulane ka tarika.
Rishta jisme "bachcha ek tarah ka baap hai" — Car ek tarah ki Vehicle hai.
lessons.what:
class Car extends Vehicle ka matlab hai: "Car ke paas wo sab kuch hai jo Vehicle ke paas hai, aur uske alawa apna bhi."

Bachche ko baap ke saare public aur protected fields/methods mil jaate hain. private (#) nahi milta — wo sirf baap ka hai.

super do jagah use hota hai:

• super(...) constructor mein — "baap ka constructor pehle chala do".
• super.method() — "baap wala version chala do".
lessons.why:
Faayda seedha hai: saanjha code ek jagah. Agar har gaadi mein ownerName chahiye, to tum use Vehicle mein ek baar likhte ho aur teeno bachchon ko mil jaata hai.

Aur ek dusra faayda jo bada hai: ek Car ko Vehicle ki jagah use kiya ja sakta hai. Isliye ParkingLot.park(vehicle: Vehicle) Car, Bike, Truck — teeno le leta hai, bina kuch jaane.

Isko "is-a" rishta kehte hain: Car ek tarah ki Vehicle hai. Ye test yaad rakho, kyunki Chapter 7 mein hum isi test se pata karenge ki inheritance galat kab hai.

Kaise karna hai:

Do niyam jo TypeScript zabardasti manwata hai:

1. Bachche ke constructor mein super(...) sabse pehle aana chahiye — this use karne se pehle. Kyunki jab tak baap ka hissa nahi bana, object adhoora hai.
2. Jo abstract method baap mein hai, bachche ko wo likhni hi padegi.

Aur ek niyam jo TypeScript nahi manwata par tumhe manna chahiye: inheritance ka istemaal sirf "is-a" ke liye karo. "Isme wo cheez hai" (has-a) ke liye nahi. Ye farak Chapter 8 ka poora vishay hai.

gotchas: super() ko constructor mein sabse pehle likho. TypeScript rok dega, par wajah samajhna zaroori hai: baap ka hissa bane bina object adhoora hai.
# private bachchon ko nahi milta. Agar bachche ko chahiye to protected use karo — par sochо ki sach mein chahiye ya nahi.
super.method() likhna bhool kar sirf method() likh doge to wo apne aap ko bulayega — infinite loop aur stack overflow. Ye ek classic bug hai.
Bachche mein baap wale field ka same naam mat rakho. Wo baap wale ko dhak deta hai (shadowing) aur bug dhundhna namumkin ho jaata hai.

lessons.name: Method overriding — baap ka kaam apne tarike se
lessons.desc: Same naam, alag kaam. Aur ek niyam jo tootne par sab kuch bigadta hai.
terms: Baap ki method ko bachche mein dobara likhna, apne tarike se.
Method ka naam + uske arguments + return type.
Bachche ko baap ki jagah rakha ja sake, bina kuch tode. (Chapter 10 mein poora)
lessons.what:
Overriding matlab: baap mein jo method hai, bachcha use apne tarike se dobara likh deta hai. Naam aur signature same rehta hai, kaam badal jaata hai.

Aur jab tum vehicle.describe() bulao, to us object ka version chalta hai — chahe variable ka type Vehicle hi kyun na ho.
lessons.why:
Ab ek bahut zaroori niyam. Override karte waqt bachche ko baap ka waada nahi todna chahiye.

Matlab: agar koi Vehicle ki umeed rakh kar code likh raha hai, to Truck de dene par uska code toot-na nahi chahiye.

Isko Liskov Substitution Principle kehte hain (Chapter 10 mein "L"). Abhi ek line yaad rakho: "bachcha baap ki jagah chup-chaap kaam kar jaana chahiye."

Kaise karna hai:

Teen cheezein jo override karte waqt galat hain:

1. Nayi shart lagana. Baap kisi bhi plate ko maanta tha, bachcha kehta hai "sirf MH wali plate chalegi" → jo code Vehicle maan kar chal raha tha wo toot jaayega.
2. Kam dena. Baap kehta tha "hamesha number dunga", bachcha kabhi-kabhi null de → caller crash.
3. Exception phenkna jahan baap nahi phenkta tha.

TypeScript mein override keyword likh sakte ho (tsconfig mein noImplicitOverride on karke zaroori bhi bana sakte ho). Wo ek galti bachaata hai: agar baap mein wo method hai hi nahi (jaise tumne naam galat likh diya), to error milegi.
gotchas: noImplicitOverride: true zaroor on karo. Method ka naam typo hone par wo chup-chaap ek nayi method ban jaati hai aur purani chalti rehti hai — sabse dhoonda na jaane wala bug.
Override karke sirf super.method() bula dena aur kuch na karna — wo bekaar code hai, hata do.
Constructor mein override kiya hua method mat bulao. Us waqt bachche ka constructor abhi chala hi nahi hai, to bachche ke fields undefined honge. Ye Java/C# ka classic trap hai.

lessons.name: Ek baap ka niyam — aur Diamond Problem
lessons.desc: Kai baap kyu allowed nahi hain, aur interface usko kaise theek karta hai.
terms: Ek class ka sirf ek baap ho sakta hai.
Kai baap — TypeScript/Java mein classes ke liye allowed nahi.
Do baap ek hi dada se aaye hon aur dono ne same method badli ho — ab kaunsi chalegi?
Kai jagah ka code jodne ka ek jugaad, bina multiple inheritance ke.
lessons.what:
TypeScript (aur Java, C#) mein ek class ka sirf ek baap ho sakta hai. class A extends B, C likhna allowed nahi hai.

Kyu? Kyunki ek gehri samasya hai jise diamond problem kehte hain.

Socho: Vehicle mein describe() hai. ElectricVehicle aur CommercialVehicle dono Vehicle se aaye hain aur dono ne describe() apne tarike se badal di. Ab ElectricTruck dono se aaye — to describe() kaunsi chalegi?

Iska koi saaf jawab nahi hai. Isliye zyadatar languages ne kaha: "hum ye problem hone hi nahi denge."
lessons.why:
Aur yahin interface ka asli faayda samajh aata hai.

Interface mein koi code nahi hota — sirf waada hota hai. To agar do interfaces mein same method ka naam ho, koi jhagda nahi: dono sirf keh rahe hain "ye method honi chahiye", aur tumhari class use ek baar likh deti hai.

Isliye niyam banta hai: "code ke liye ek baap. Waadon ke liye jitne chaaho interfaces."

Kaise karna hai:

Practical faisla:

• extends — ek. Wahan jahan saanjha code hai.
• implements — jitne chaaho. Wahan jahan sirf roop batana hai.

Aur agar tumhe sach mein do jagah se code chahiye? To wo ek nishani hai ki inheritance galat auzaar hai — tumhe composition chahiye. Aur wahi Chapter 8 hai.

TypeScript mein mixin naam ka ek jugaad bhi hai jo multiple inheritance jaisa kaam karta hai. Wo chalta hai, par padhne mein bhaari hota hai. Is kitaab mein hum composition chunenge.

"Mujhe do jagah se code chahiye" — ye hamesha ek signal hai ki design mein kuch galat hai. Ruk kar sochо ki kya wo cheezein sach mein "is-a" hain.

lessons.name: Poochho mat ki tum kaun ho — bas kaam bolo
lessons.desc: instanceof ki chain ko ek method call se badal do.
terms: Ek hi naam ka method alag-alag classes mein alag kaam karta hai.
Chalte waqt decide hona ki kaunsi class ka version chalega.
Ye check karna ki object kis class ka hai. Aksar ek design smell hai.
lessons.what:
Do tarike hain kaam karwane ke:

Tarika 1 (bura) — pooch-taach karo: "tum Car ho? To 30. Bike ho? To 20."
Tarika 2 (achha) — kaam bolo: "tumhara rate kya hai?" Aur har gaadi khud jawab de.

Dusre tarike mein tumhara code ko ye pata hi nahi hota ki kaunsi gaadi hai. Isko dynamic dispatch kehte hain — chalte waqt object khud decide karta hai ki kaunsa version chalega.

Analogy: manager do tarah ke hote hain. Ek wo jo har bande se poochta hai "tum designer ho? to ye karo. developer ho? to wo karo." Aur ek wo jo bas kehta hai "apna kaam karo" — aur har banda jaanta hai ki uska kaam kya hai. Dusra manager scale karta hai, pehla nahi.
lessons.why:
if-else chain ki teen problem hain:

1. Naya type = purani file kholni padegi. Aur wo bhi har jagah jahan wo chain hai.
2. Ek jagah bhoolna bahut aasan hai. Aur compiler tumhe nahi batayega.
3. Chain bikhri hui hoti hai. Ek chain pricing mein, ek report mein, ek allotment mein — teeno ko update karna padta hai.

Polymorphism ke saath: naya type = ek nayi class, aur compiler tumhe har method likhwa kar hi manega.

Kaise karna hai:

Refactor ka tarika seedha hai, teen kadam:

1. if-else/switch chain dhundo jo type par based ho.
2. Us chain ke har branch ko us class ke andar ek method bana do.
3. Chain ko ek method call se badal do.

Aur ek zaroori signal: agar tum instanceof likh rahe ho, to 90% chance hai ki wahan polymorphism hona chahiye. (10% cases mein wo sach mein zaroori hota hai — jaise error types check karna.)

lessons.name: Overloading vs Overriding — do alag cheezein
lessons.desc: Naam milte-julte hain, kaam bilkul alag. Interview mein pakka poocha jaata hai.
terms: Baap ki method ko bachche mein dobara likhna. Chalte waqt decide hota hai.
Ek hi naam ki kai methods, alag arguments ke saath. Likhte waqt decide hota hai.
Overriding ka dusra naam — chalte waqt object decide karta hai.
Overloading ka dusra naam — likhte waqt compiler decide karta hai.
lessons.what:
Ye do shabd har OOP interview mein aate hain, aur log inhe ghol dete hain. Farak seedha hai:

Overriding — alag classes mein, same signature. "Bachcha baap ka kaam apne tarike se karta hai." Kaunsa chalega ye chalte waqt pata chalta hai.

Overloading — ek hi class mein, alag signature. "Ek hi naam, alag arguments ke liye alag version." Kaunsa chalega ye likhte waqt pata chal jaata hai.
lessons.why:
Aur ek zaroori baat: JavaScript mein overloading asli nahi hai.

JavaScript mein ek naam ka ek hi function ho sakta hai. TypeScript tumhe "overload signatures" likhne deta hai, par wo sirf lebal hain — asal mein ek hi function banta hai jise tumhe khud if se handle karna padta hai.

Java/C# mein overloading asli hoti hai — wahan sach mein alag-alag methods banti hain.

Kaise karna hai:

Yaad rakhne ka sabse aasan tarika:

Overriding — id = identity. Naya banda (class) wahi kaam karta hai.
Overloading — load = bojh. Wahi banda alag bojh (arguments) uthata hai.

Aur ek practical salah: TypeScript mein overloading se bachо. Uski jagah optional parameters ya union type use karo — code saaf rehta hai aur ek hi jagah rehta hai.

visual.cap: Do shabd, do bilkul alag cheezein. Overriding chalte waqt object decide karta hai; overloading likhte waqt compiler. Aur JS/TS mein overloading sirf lebal hai — asal function ek hi banta hai.

Overloading ko polymorphism ka "asli" roop mat samjho. Asli polymorphism overriding hai — wo chalte waqt kaam karta hai aur naye types ke saath apne aap chalta rehta hai.
Interview mein "compile-time vs runtime polymorphism" poocha jaaye to yahi do cheezein hain: overloading = compile-time, overriding = runtime.

lessons.name: Poore system par lagao — aur naapo
lessons.desc: Har if-else chain dhundo, hatao, aur farak gino.
terms: Aisa code jo galat nahi hai par ishara karta hai ki design mein kuch theek nahi.
Ek chhota badlav karne ke liye 5 jagah file kholni pade — ek jaani-maani problem.
lessons.what:
Ab ye soch poore parking lot par lagate hain. Apne code mein teen tarah ke smell dhundo:

1. instanceof ya constructor.name ka check
2. switch (type) ya if (type === "...")
3. Aisi property jiska naam hi "type" ya "kind" ho, aur uspe branching ho

Har ek ko ek method call se badlo.
lessons.why:
Jab ek chhota badlav karne ke liye 5 file kholni padein, use shotgun surgery kehte hain — aur wo sabse mehngi problem hai kyunki har baar ek jagah bhoolne ka chance rehta hai.

Polymorphism iska seedha ilaaj hai: ek naya type = ek nayi file, baaki sab wahi ke wahi.

Aur ye naapa ja sakta hai — is chapter ka milestone yahi hai.

Kaise karna hai:

Ek chhota par bahut kaam ka pattern: agar tumhe polymorphism ke saath ek "default" behaviour bhi chahiye, to use baap mein normal method bana do (abstract nahi), aur jise chahiye wo override kar le.

Aur ek jagah jahan instanceof sahi hai: jab object bahar se aa raha ho (JSON, library) aur tumhare paas uske upar control na ho. Wahan pehle usko apne type mein badlo, phir polymorphism.
gotchas: Har cheez ko polymorphic mat bana do. Agar ek behaviour sirf ek class ke liye hai aur kabhi doosri ko nahi chahiye, to use baap mein daalne ki zarurat nahi.
Baap mein 15 abstract methods ho jaayein to har naye subclass ko 15 methods likhni padengi. Ye ek nishani hai ki hierarchy bahut kuch kar rahi hai — Chapter 7 mein iska naam milega.
Default behaviour dene ka matlab ye nahi ki hamesha safe hai. Agar default galat ho to naya subclass chup-chaap galat kaam karega. Sochо: default hona chahiye ya abstract?

units.title: Inheritance ki deewar — jab ped phat jaata hai

lessons.name: Subclasses ka pahaad — khud gino
lessons.desc: Do alag baatein mil kar chaar classes maangti hain. Teen baatein — aath.
terms: Jab do-teen cheezein aapas mein mil kar classes ki ginti kai guna bada dein.
Do baatein jo ek doosre se bilkul azaad hon — jaise "electric hona" aur "handicap hona".
lessons.what:
Tumhare paas Car, Bike, Truck hain. Ab teen nayi baatein aayin:

• Electric hai ya nahi
• Handicap ke liye hai ya nahi
• VIP hai ya nahi

Ye teeno ek doosre se bilkul azaad hain — ek electric gaadi handicap bhi ho sakti hai aur VIP bhi. Aise azaad baaton ko orthogonal kehte hain.

Ab gino: 3 vehicle types × 2 (electric ya nahi) × 2 (handicap ya nahi) × 2 (VIP ya nahi) = 24 classes.
lessons.why:
Aur ye sirf ginti ka masla nahi hai. Har nayi baat classes ko dugna kar deti hai:

Ek nayi baat jodo (jaise "diesel hai ya nahi") → 48 classes.
Ek aur → 96.

Aur inme se zyadatar classes mein same code copy hoga. ElectricCar aur ElectricTruck dono mein plugIn() ka wahi code likha hoga — kyunki dono ka baap alag hai aur wo code share nahi kar sakte.

Ye inheritance ki sabse badi seema hai: wo sirf ek dimension mein kaam karta hai.

Kaise karna hai:

Iska jad ye hai: ek class ka sirf ek baap hota hai (Chapter 5 wala niyam). To agar tumhe do azaad baatein ek saath chahiye, to hierarchy mein unke liye jagah hi nahi hai — tumhe har combination ke liye ek nayi class banani padegi.

Aur jab tum ye pahaad khud bana kar ginoge, tab tumhe apne aap samajh aayega ki jawab kya hona chahiye: in baaton ko "class" banane ki jagah "cheez" bana do jo gaadi ke andar rakhi ja sake.

Par abhi jawab mat sochо. Aaj sirf pahaad bana kar gino.

visual.cap: Do azaad baatein = 4 classes. Teen = 8. Chaar = 16. Aur inme se zyadatar mein same code copy hoga, kyunki alag shaakhon ke bachche code share nahi kar sakte.

Ye mat sochо ki "main itni classes nahi banaunga". Ye classes ek-ek karke, mahino mein banti hain, aur har ek us waqt sahi lagti hai.
Asli codebases mein ye pahaad 3 saal mein khud-ba-khud khada ho jaata hai. Koi ek din baith kar 24 classes nahi banata.

lessons.name: Fragile base class — baap mein ek line, bachche toote
lessons.desc: Inheritance ek bahut mazboot bandhan hai. Aur mazboot bandhan tootne par zyada dard deta hai.
terms: Aisi baap-class jisme chhota badlav bhi bachchon ko tod deta hai.
Do cheezein itni juri hui hon ki ek badalne par doosri toot jaaye.
Aisa reuse jisme tumhe andar ka code jaanna padta hai — inheritance aisa hi hai.
lessons.what:
Inheritance ka ek pehlu log kam batate hain: bachche apne baap ke andar ka code jaante hain aur uspe nirbhar hote hain.

Agar baap ne apna andar ka tarika badla — chahe uska bahar ka behaviour bilkul same rahe — to bachche toot sakte hain.

Isko white-box reuse kehte hain: tumhe reuse karne ke liye andar ka dabba khol kar dekhna padta hai. Iska ulta black-box reuse hai — sirf bahar ka darwaza use karo, andar kya hai matlab nahi. (Wo Chapter 8 mein aayega.)
lessons.why:
Ek classic example, aur ye asli hai:

Baap mein park() hai jo andar-andar parkOne() ko bulata hai. Bachche ne parkOne() override kiya taaki ek counter badha sake.

Ab baap ka developer park() ko optimize karta hai — ab wo parkOne() nahi bulata, seedha kaam kar deta hai. Baap ka bahar ka behaviour bilkul same hai. Par bachche ka counter chup-chaap kaam karna band kar deta hai.

Aur sabse buri baat: baap ke developer ko pata bhi nahi ki usne kisi ko toda hai.

Kaise karna hai:

Isliye ek bada niyam hai: class ko ya to inheritance ke liye design karo (aur likh kar batao ki kaunsi method kab bulti hai), ya usko band kar do.

Java mein final, C# mein sealed. TypeScript mein aisa keyword nahi hai — par tum private constructor ya composition se wahi kaam kar sakte ho.

Aur practical salah: apni hi class ke andar ek method dusri method ko bulaye — is par bachche ko nirbhar mat hone do. Agar wo zaroori hai to use document karo (isko "self-use documentation" kehte hain).
gotchas: Ye problem library authors ke liye sabse badi hai. Agar tumhari class ko bahar ke log extend karte hain, to tum apna andar ka code kabhi nahi badal sakte.
protected method public API ka hissa hai — chahe wo "protected" likha ho. Jaise hi koi use override karta hai, tum use tod nahi sakte.
Ye tab tak nahi dikhta jab tak koi tootta nahi. Aur toot-ne par bug bilkul ajeeb jagah dikhta hai (counter 0 hai) na ki wahan jahan asli badlav hua tha.

lessons.name: is-a test fail — jab "ek tarah ki" jhooth ban jaata hai
lessons.desc: Chapter 5 ka test yaad hai? Aaj wo fail hoga — aur wahi asli signal hai.
terms: "Kya X ek tarah ka Y hai?" — inheritance sahi hai ya nahi, ye batane wala sawaal.
Bachche ko baap ki jagah rakha ja sake bina kuch tode.
Sirf shape milna kaafi nahi — behaviour bhi milna chahiye.
lessons.what:
Chapter 5 mein humne kaha tha: inheritance tab use karo jab "is-a" sach ho. Aaj dekhte hain ki wo sawaal itna aasan nahi hai.

Classic example: kya Square ek tarah ka Rectangle hai?

Ganit mein — haan. Code mein — nahi. Kyunki Rectangle ka waada hai "width aur height alag-alag set ho sakti hain", aur Square us waade ko tod deta hai.
lessons.why:
Aur hamare parking lot mein bhi bilkul yahi ho raha hai. Sochо:

Kya Motorcycle ek tarah ki Bike hai? Shape mein haan. Par agar Bike ka waada hai "bina permit ke park ho sakti hai" aur motorcycle ko permit chahiye — to wo waada toot gaya.

Kya ElectricCar ek tarah ki Car hai? Haan... par agar tumne maxHours() 24 se 8 kar diya, to jo code Car maan kar 12 ghante ka booking bana raha tha wo toot jaayega.

Yaani is-a sirf shape ka sawaal nahi hai, behaviour ka sawaal hai. Isko behavioural subtyping kehte hain.

Kaise karna hai:

Asli test ye hai (aur ye Chapter 5 wala contract test hi hai):

"Kya main har jagah baap ki jagah bachcha rakh dun aur kuch na toote?"

lessons.name: has-a — cheez ko field bana lo
lessons.desc: Ek line ka badlav, aur 24 classes 4 ho jaati hain.
terms: Ek object ke andar doosre objects rakhna, aur unse kaam karwana.
"Isme wo cheez HAI" — Car ke paas Battery hai.
Kaam khud na karke andar wale object se karwana.
Sirf bahar ka darwaza use karna, andar ka code jaane bina.
lessons.what:
Inheritance kehta hai: "Car ek tarah ki Vehicle hai." (is-a)
Composition kehta hai: "Car ke paas ek Engine hai." (has-a)

Ab "electric hona" ko dekho. Wo ek type nahi hai — wo ek khoobi hai. To use class banane ki jagah cheez bana do:

class Car { #power: PowerSource }

Aur PowerSource ya to Battery ho sakta hai ya PetrolTank.
lessons.why:
Ab dekho Chapter 7 ki teeno deewaren kaise girti hain:

1. Explosion khatam. 3 azaad baatein = 3 fields, na ki 8 classes. Vehicle types 3 hi rehte hain.

2. Fragile base class khatam. Car ko Battery ke andar ka code nahi pata — wo sirf battery.charge() bulata hai. Battery apna andar jab chahe badle, Car nahi tootegi. Ye black-box reuse hai.

3. is-a ka sawaal hi khatam. Ab koi "ek tarah ka" hai hi nahi, to waada tootne ka sawaal hi nahi.

Aur ek bonus jo inheritance kar hi nahi sakta: field chalte waqt badla ja sakta hai. Petrol car ko electric bana do — ek line.

Kaise karna hai:

Refactor ka tarika:

1. Har subclass dekho aur poocho: "ye kya jodta hai?" (battery, permit, valet)
2. Us cheez ki ek chhoti class banao.
3. Use parent class mein ek field bana do.
4. Subclass delete kar do.

Aur ek achhi aadat: un cheezon ko interface bana do (PowerSource), na ki concrete class. Phir naye types bina kisi ko chhoote add ho jaate hain.

gotchas: Har chhoti cheez ke liye class mat bana do. Agar wo cheez sirf ek boolean hai aur uska koi behaviour nahi, to boolean hi rakho. Class tab banao jab uske apne kaam hon.
Default values dena zaroori hai, warna har jagah new Car("A","x", new PetrolTank(40), new StandardAccess(), new RegularService()) likhna padega — aur wo padhne mein bura hai.
4 se zyada cheezein ho jaayein to constructor object parameter par switch karo (Chapter 2 wala sabak).
Composition ka matlab inheritance ka poora tyag nahi hai. Vehicle -> Car abhi bhi inheritance hai, aur wo sahi hai, kyunki Car sach mein ek tarah ki Vehicle hai.

lessons.name: Delegation — kaam aage pass karo
lessons.desc: Andar wale object se kaam karwao. Aur "kitna aage pass karna hai" ka faisla.
terms: Apna kaam khud na karke andar rakhe object se karwana.
Ek class jo andar wale objects ko chhupa kar ek saaf darwaza deti hai.
Bekaar dohraya jaane wala code — jaise bahut saare ek-line delegation methods.
lessons.what:
Jab tum car.getHourlyRate() bulate ho aur andar wo this.service.rateMultiplier() bulata hai — usko delegation kehte hain. Car apna kaam khud nahi kar rahi; wo andar wale object se karwa rahi hai.

Ye composition ka dusra aadha hai. Cheez ko field banana pehla aadha hai; usse kaam karwana dusra.
lessons.why:
Delegation ka bada faayda ye hai ki Car tay karti hai ki bahar kya dikhega.

Inheritance mein baap ka poora public API bachche mein apne aap aa jaata hai — chahe tum chaaho ya nahi. Composition mein tum chunte ho ki kya aage pass karna hai.

Isliye composition ke saath tumhara public API chhota aur soch-samajh kar bana hua rehta hai. Inheritance ke saath wo apne aap phoolta jaata hai.

Kaise karna hai:

Ek asli problem: agar andar wale object ki 10 methods bahar chahiye, to tumhe 10 ek-line methods likhni padengi. Isko boilerplate kehte hain, aur ye composition ki asli keemat hai.

Teen tarike:

1. Sirf wo methods likho jo sach mein bahar chahiye (aksar 10 mein se 3).
2. Andar wale object ko readonly getter se bahar de do — par tab encapsulation thodi kam ho jaati hai.
3. Ek interface bana do jo dono implement karein.

Zyadatar cases mein pehla sahi hai — aur wo boilerplate asal mein ek faayda hai, kyunki wo tumhe sochne par majboor karta hai ki bahar kya chahiye.
gotchas: Andar wale object ko getter se bahar de dena (get battery() { return this.#battery; }) — isse encapsulation toot jaata hai aur bahar wale seedha uspe kaam karne lagte hain.
Delegation methods mein logic mat daalo. Agar ek method sirf aage pass kar rahi hai to theek; agar wo 10 line ka kaam bhi kar rahi hai to shayad wo logic galat jagah hai.
Bahut saari delegation methods likhni pad rahi hain — ye signal hai ki shayad wo cheez andar honi hi nahi chahiye, ya tumhara class bahut kuch kar raha hai (Chapter 12 ka God object).

lessons.name: Kab inheritance, kab composition
lessons.desc: Dono ke apne kaam hain. Ek faisla-list jo tum yaad rakh sako.
terms: Ek jaani-mani salah: shak ho to composition chuno.
Behaviour ko object bana kar bahar se dena — jo tumne aaj bina naam jaane bana liya.
lessons.what:
Ye chapter "inheritance bura hai" nahi keh raha. Inheritance sahi jagah par bilkul sahi hai.

Tumhare code mein Car extends Vehicle abhi bhi hai — aur wo sahi hai, kyunki Car sach mein ek tarah ki Vehicle hai, aur uska koi waada nahi tootta.

Jo hata hai wo hai ElectricCar extends Car — kyunki "electric hona" ek khoobi thi, type nahi.
lessons.why:
Industry ki salah hai: "favour composition over inheritance" — matlab shak ho to composition chuno. Iski wajah statistics hai: log inheritance ka galat istemaal composition ke galat istemaal se kai guna zyada karte hain.

Par "favour" ka matlab "kabhi mat use karo" nahi hai. Inheritance ke teen sahi kaam hain:

1. Saanjha code + is-a jab wo sach mein sach ho (Vehicle → Car)
2. Framework ka contract jab library bolti hai "meri class extend karo"
3. Abstract class jab tumhe kuch code dena ho aur kuch likhwana ho

Kaise karna hai:

Ek faisla-list. Har naye rishte par ye chaar sawaal poocho:

1. Kya main har jagah baap ki jagah bachcha rakh sakta hu, bina kisi "par" ke?
2. Kya ye ek type hai ya ek khoobi? (Khoobi = composition)
3. Kya ye chalte waqt badal sakti hai? (Haan = composition, kyunki class badalti nahi)
4. Kya ye kai cheezon ke saath mil sakti hai? (Haan = composition, warna explosion)

Ek bhi jagah composition ka jawab aaya, to composition chuno.

lessons.name: has-a ke teen roop — Composition, Aggregation, Association
lessons.desc: Sab "has-a" ek jaise nahi hote. Sawaal ye hai: maalik kaun hai, aur kaun kiske saath marta hai.
terms: Sabse kasa hua rishta — andar wali cheez bahar wali ke saath hi paida hoti hai aur uske saath hi khatam.
Dheela rishta — andar wali cheez bahar se aati hai aur bahar wale ke marne ke baad bhi zinda rehti hai.
Sabse dheela — do cheezein bas ek doosre ko jaanti hain, koi maalik nahi.
Kisi cheez ka jeevan — kab bani, kab khatam hui.
Maalikana — kaun kiske banne aur mitne ka zimmedaar hai.
lessons.what:
Ab tak humne "has-a" ko ek hi cheez samjha. Par asal mein uske teen roop hain, aur farak ek hi sawaal se pata chalta hai:

"Agar bahar wali cheez khatam ho jaaye, to andar wali ka kya hoga?"

Composition — andar wali bhi khatam. ParkingLot ke Spots: lot hi nahi rahi to spots ka koi matlab nahi. Spots lot ke andar bante hain.

Aggregation — andar wali zinda rehti hai. ParkingLot ka PricingPolicy: lot band ho gayi, par wahi pricing doosri lot use kar sakti hai. Wo bahar bani thi aur inject hui thi.

Association — koi maalik hi nahi. Ticket aur Vehicle: dono ek doosre ko jaante hain, par na koi kisi ko banata hai, na mitata hai.
lessons.why:
Ye sirf naam ka khel nahi hai — ye batata hai ki cheez banegi kahan.

Composition → andar new karo. this.#spots.push(new Spot(...)). Ye ek jagah hai jahan new likhna sahi hai (Chapter 9 ke "new mat likho" wale niyam ka apwad).

Aggregation → constructor se lo. Ye Dependency Injection hi hai (Chapter 9). Yaani tumne DI use kiya kyunki wo rishta aggregation tha, composition nahi.

Association → sirf ek reference rakho, ya sirf uski id rakho.

Aur interview mein "composition aur aggregation mein farak" seedha poocha jaata hai — jawab hamesha lifecycle aur ownership hai.

Kaise karna hai:

Ek chhota par bahut kaam ka faisla: association mein poora object rakhna zaroori nahi hai — aksar sirf id behtar hai.

Ticket mein poora Vehicle rakhoge to ticket us gaadi ko zinda rakhega (memory), aur ticket ko save karte waqt poori gaadi bhi save karni padegi. Sirf plate rakho — kaam ho jaata hai aur rishta dheela rehta hai.

Aur ek imaandar baat: rozmarra ki baat mein log teeno ko "composition" hi keh dete hain (jaise "composition over inheritance" mein). Ye galat nahi hai — bas jaan lo ki UML mein teen alag cheezein hain, taaki interview mein farak bata sako.

visual.cap: Ek hi sawaal se teeno alag ho jaate hain: "bahar wali khatam ho gayi to andar wali ka kya hoga?" Aur uska jawab ye bhi batata hai ki cheez banegi kahan — andar new, ya bahar se inject.

units.title: Coupling, DI aur Immutability — design ko naapo

lessons.name: Coupling aur Cohesion — design ka thermometer
lessons.desc: Do shabd jo batate hain ki design achha hai ya bura. Aur dono naape ja sakte hain.
terms: Do cheezein kitni juri hui hain — ek badle to doosri kitni tootegi.
Ek class ke andar ki cheezein kitni aapas mein judi hain — sab ek hi kaam ke liye hain ya nahi.
Kam juri hui — badalna aasan. Ye achha hai.
Ek class ek hi kaam karti hai. Ye achha hai.
lessons.what:
Coupling = do cheezon ke beech ka bandhan. "Agar A badla to B kitna tootega?"

Cohesion = ek cheez ke andar ka jud-av. "Kya is class ki saari cheezein ek hi kaam ke liye hain?"

Analogy: ek almari mein sirf kapde hon aur wo saaf tarah se rakhe hon — high cohesion. Almari mein kapde, bartan, kitaabein aur auzaar sab mile hue hon — low cohesion.

Aur agar tumhari almari khol-ne ke liye padosi ka darwaza kholna pade — tight coupling. Agar wo apne aap khulti hai — loose coupling.

Achha design ka mantra: low coupling, high cohesion.
lessons.why:
Ye do shabd sirf theory nahi hain — dono naape ja sakte hain:

Coupling naapne ke tarike:
• Ek file kitni doosri files import karti hai?
• Ek class badalne par kitni files badalni padti hain?
• Ek class test karne ke liye kitni doosri classes banani padti hain?

Cohesion naapne ke tarike:
• Kya class ka naam uske saare methods ko cover karta hai?
• Kya har method class ke zyadatar fields use karti hai?
• Kya tum class ko ek line mein "ye ___ karta hai" bina "aur" ke bata sakte ho?

Kaise karna hai:

Sabse aasan aur sabse imaandar test: "is class ko test karne ke liye mujhe kitni cheezein banani padti hain?"

Agar ParkingLot test karne ke liye tumhe asli database, asli payment gateway aur asli clock chahiye — to coupling bahut high hai.

Agar tum new ParkingLot(fakeSpots, fakePricing, fakeClock) likh kar turant test kar sakte ho — coupling low hai.

Testability coupling ka thermometer hai. Jo test karna mushkil hai, wo design bhi bura hai — hamesha.

gotchas: Zero coupling namumkin hai — agar kuch bhi kisi se juda na ho to system kaam hi nahi karega. Manzil "loose" coupling hai, "no" coupling nahi.
Bahut chhoti classes bana kar cohesion badhane ki koshish mat karo. 50 classes jinme har ek mein ek method ho — wo bhi bura design hai.
Coupling ko sirf import count se mat naapo. Ek import jo poore interface par nirbhar ho wo paanch chhote imports se zyada khatarnak hai.

lessons.name: Dependency Injection — cheezein bahar se do
lessons.desc: Class khud apni cheezein na banaye. Aur isse test 3 line ka ho jaata hai.
terms: Wo cheez jiske bina class kaam nahi kar sakti — jaise ParkingLot ko spots chahiye.
Cheezein class ko bahar se dena, class khud na banaye.
Sabse aam DI — cheezein constructor se aati hain.
Test ke liye banayi gayi nakli cheez jo asli ki jagah kaam kare.
lessons.what:
Agar ParkingLot ko spots, pricing aur clock chahiye — to wo unhe khud banaye ya bahar se maange?

Dependency Injection ka jawab: bahar se maango.

constructor(private spots: SpotRepository, private clock: Clock)

Bas. Ye poora concept hai. Naam bada hai, cheez chhoti hai.
lessons.why:
Teen bade faayde:

1. Test 3 line ka ho jaata hai. Nakli spots, nakli clock — aur test turant chalta hai, bina database ya network ke.

2. Ek hi class, alag configurations. Airport ke liye alag pricing, mall ke liye alag — ParkingLot ka code ek line nahi badalta.

3. Coupling gir jaati hai. ParkingLot ko ab ArraySpotRepo ka naam bhi nahi pata — use sirf SpotRepository interface pata hai.

Aur wo tisra point Chapter 10 ka "D" (Dependency Inversion) ban jaayega.

Kaise karna hai:

Clock ka case sabse zaroori hai, kyunki wo sabse zyada bhoola jaata hai.

Jo bhi class new Date() ya Date.now() likhti hai, wo test karna namumkin ho jaati hai — kyunki tum waqt aage nahi badha sakte. Iska ilaaj hai: waqt ko bhi ek cheez bana do.

interface Clock { now(): Date }

Asli mein SystemClock, test mein FakeClock jise tum aage badha sako.

Yahi baat randomness (Math.random), file system, aur network par bhi lagti hai. Jo bhi bahar ki duniya ko chhoota hai, use inject karo.

lessons.name: Immutability aur Value Objects — galat ho hi na sake
lessons.desc: Ek Money class jo negative ho hi nahi sakti. Aur readonly ka dhokha.
terms: Aisa object jo banne ke baad kabhi badalta nahi. Badalna ho to naya banta hai.
Aisi chhoti class jiski pehchaan uski VALUE se hai, uske id se nahi — jaise ₹100 aur ₹100 ek hi hain.
Har cheez ko number/string rakhna, jabki uske apne niyam hain.
Andar ka array/object bahar dete waqt uski copy dena.
lessons.what:
Abhi tumhari earnings ek number hai. Aur number ke apne koi niyam nahi hain — wo negative ho sakta hai, NaN ho sakta hai, aur usme rupaye aur paise ka koi farak nahi.

Isko primitive obsession kehte hain: har cheez ko number/string rakhna, jabki us cheez ke apne niyam hain.

Iska ilaaj: ek chhoti Money class banao jo galat ho hi na sake.
lessons.why:
Aur ab dono ideas ko jodo — immutable value object:

• Banne ke baad kabhi badalta nahi (immutable)
• Uski pehchaan uski value se hai, id se nahi (₹100 aur ₹100 ek hi hain)

Iske teen bade faayde hain: (1) galat state ban hi nahi sakti, (2) kisi ko de do to wo use bigaad nahi sakta, (3) test karna trivial hai.

Kaise karna hai:

Ab ek bahut zaroori baat jo bahut log nahi jaante:

readonly spots: Spot[] — ye array ko immutable nahi banata. Wo sirf this.spots = ... rokta hai. this.spots.push(...) abhi bhi chalta hai!

Do asli tarike:

1. ReadonlyArray<Spot> — ab push par bhi error milegi (compile time).
2. Defensive copy — bahar dete waqt [...this.#spots] do, taaki bahar wala jo chahe kare.

visual.cap: readonly ka dhokha: wo sirf reassign rokta hai, andar badalne se nahi. Aur value object ka faayda: galat state ban hi nahi sakti, aur test 1 line ka hota hai.

lessons.name: Law of Demeter — ajnabiyon se baat mat karo
lessons.desc: Ek dot theek, teen dot khatra. Aur wo train wreck kyu tootti hai.
terms: Ek niyam: sirf apne padosiyon se baat karo, unke padosiyon se nahi.
a.b().c().d().e() jaisa code — dekhne mein rail ka dabba, tootne mein bhi.
"Data maang kar khud kaam mat karo — kaam bol do."
lessons.what:
Ek chhota niyam jiska bada asar hai. Ek method sirf inse baat kare:

1. Khud se (this)
2. Apne fields se
3. Apne parameters se
4. Jo objects usne khud banaye

Yaani apne padosiyon se baat karo, padosiyon ke padosiyon se nahi.

Analogy: tumhe dukandaar se saaman lena hai. Tum uski jeb mein haath daal kar khud paise nikaal loge? Nahi — tum bolte ho "itne ka saaman do" aur wo khud sambhaal leta hai. Par code mein hum roz jeb mein haath daalte hain: lot.getSpots()[0].getVehicle().getOwner().getAddress().city
lessons.why:
Aisi lambi chain ko train wreck kehte hain, aur wo isliye khatarnak hai ki har dot ek nirbharta hai.

a.b().c().d() mein tum a, b, c teeno ke andar ke dhaanche par nirbhar ho. Inme se koi ek badla — tumhara code toot gaya.

Aur ye Chapter 3 wale encapsulation ko bhi tod deta hai: agar tum lot.getSpots()[0].takenBy likh sakte ho, to Spot ka private hona bekaar hai.

Kaise karna hai:

Ilaaj ek line ka hai: "tell, don't ask" — data maang kar khud kaam mat karo, kaam bol do.

Galat: if (lot.getSpots().filter(s => s.isFree()).length > 0) { ... }
Sahi: if (lot.hasFreeSpot()) { ... }

Aur ek zaroori chhoot: ye niyam fluent APIs par nahi lagta. arr.filter().map().reduce() ya builder.setA().setB().build() theek hain, kyunki wahan har call wahi cheez lautati hai — tum naye ajnabiyon se nahi mil rahe.
gotchas: Isko andha niyam mat banao. Kabhi-kabhi ek chhota chain padhne mein zyada saaf hota hai. Sochо: "kya main yahan kisi ke andar ka dhaancha maan raha hu?"
Iska ilaaj karte waqt bahut saari delegation methods ban jaati hain (Chapter 8 wala boilerplate). Wo theek hai — par agar bahut zyada ho to shayad classes ka batwara galat hai.
Fluent APIs (filter/map/builder) par ye niyam nahi lagta. Wahan har call wahi cheez lautati hai.

lessons.name: Shallow aur Deep copy — Chapter 1 wali galti ka naam
lessons.desc: Copy banane ke do tarike hain, aur ek chup-chaap original ko badal deta hai.
terms: Ek object ka pata (address), khud object nahi. Do variables ek hi object ka pata rakh sakte hain.
Upar-upar ki copy — andar wale objects ki nahi, sirf unke pate copy hote hain.
Poori copy — andar tak sab kuch naya banta hai.
Bahar bhejne se pehle copy bana kar dena, taaki bahar wala original na badal sake.
lessons.what:
Chapter 1 mein maine ek chhoti si baat chhod di thi. Yaad hai?

const s = spots[0];
s.takenBy = "kuch bhi";
// humne sirf ek variable copy kiya tha... aur original badal gaya

Us cheez ka naam hai: tumne object copy nahi kiya tha, sirf uska pata copy kiya tha.

JavaScript mein object variables mein object nahi hota — uska pata (reference) hota hai. To const s = spots[0] ka matlab hai "s bhi ussi ghar ka pata rakhta hai". Do naam, ek hi ghar.
lessons.why:
Ab yahan asli khatra hai, aur wo [...arr] mein chhupa hai.

Tumne Chapter 3 mein likha tha: get spots() { return [...this.#spots]; } — "copy de raha hu, safe hai".

Wo aadha sach hai. [...arr] ek naya array banata hai, par usme wahi purane Spot objects ke pate hain. Yaani:

✓ Bahar wala copy.push(...) kar de — tumhara array safe hai
✗ Bahar wala copy[0].takenBy = "X" kar de — tumhara Spot BADAL GAYA

Ye sabse zyada chhookar nikal jaane wala bug hai, kyunki code dekh kar lagta hai ki tumne copy de di.

Kaise karna hai:

Teen hal, aur teeno ki apni jagah hai:

1. Deep copy — structuredClone(). Poora naya. Par ye classes ko plain object bana deta hai (methods gayab), to ye sirf plain data ke liye theek hai.

2. Khud ka clone() — class khud apni copy banaye. Sabse control wala tarika.

3. Immutable bana do — sabse achha. Agar Spot badal hi nahi sakti, to copy ki zarurat hi nahi. Yahi wajah hai ki Money aur PlateNumber ko humne immutable banaya tha.

Yaani Chapter 9 ka immutability wala sabak is problem ka sabse saaf ilaaj hai — copy ki zarurat hi khatam kar do.

visual.cap: Shallow copy naya dabba banata hai par andar purane hi pate rakhta hai. Isliye [...arr] array ko bachata hai, par andar ke objects ko nahi — aur yahi sabse chhookar nikal jaane wala bug hai.

units.title: SOLID — paanch niyam jo tum pehle hi bana chuke ho

lessons.name: S — Single Responsibility: ek class, ek kaam
lessons.desc: Class badalne ki ek hi wajah honi chahiye. Aur "wajah" ka matlab "insaan" hai.
terms: Ek class ke badalne ki sirf ek wajah honi chahiye.
Ek kaam jiske liye ye class zimmedaar hai.
Wo insaan ya team jiske kehne par ye code badalta hai.
lessons.what:
Definition: A class should have only one reason to change.

"Ek reason to change" ka matlab log aksar galat samajhte hain. Iska matlab "ek method" nahi hai. Iska matlab hai: ek class ke badalne ke peeche ek hi insaan (ya team) hona chahiye.

Tumhari ParkingLot abhi ye sab karti hai: spots manage, fee calculate, notification bhejna, report banana. Ab sochо ki inhe kaun badalwaata hai:

• Spots ka logic → operations team
• Fee ka logic → finance team
• Notification → marketing team
• Report → management

Chaar alag log, ek hi file. Yahi SRP ka tootna hai.
lessons.why:
Iska practical nuksaan seedha hai: finance team ne rate badalne ko kaha, tumne ParkingLot.ts kholi — aur galti se notification ka code tod diya. Marketing team ka feature raat ko fail ho gaya.

Do bilkul alag wajah se badalne wali cheezein ek file mein hon, to har badlav doosri ko todne ka khatra rakhta hai.

Aur ye Chapter 9 wale cohesion ka hi doosra roop hai — bas isko naap-ne ka ek behtar sawaal mil gaya: "isko kaun badalwaata hai?"

Kaise karna hai:

Test karne ka tarika: class ka kaam ek line mein, bina "aur" ke likho.

✗ "ParkingLot spots manage karta hai aur fee calculate karta hai aur SMS bhejta hai"
✓ "ParkingLot spots allot aur release karta hai"
✓ "PricingPolicy ticket aur waqt se fee nikaalti hai"
✓ "Notifier message bhejta hai"

Aur ek chetavani: SRP ko bahut door tak mat le jao. Har method ki apni class banana ("Anemic domain model") apni tarah ka bura design hai. Test "wajah" ka hai, "kaam ki ginti" ka nahi.

visual.cap: SRP ka asli test "kitne methods hain" nahi, "kitne alag log isko badalwaate hain" hai. Chaar teams ek file mein = har badlav doosri team ka feature todne ka khatra.
